import json, xmlrpc.client, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/work")
log=root/".odoo-agents/flow-artifacts/needs-review/studio_diff.log"
p=root/"changelog/2026-09-09_01_revue-des-locations-d-22/studio/pack.json"
common=xmlrpc.client.ServerProxy("http://127.0.0.1:52795/xmlrpc/2/common")
uid=common.authenticate("lab_client","admin","admin",{})
rpc=xmlrpc.client.ServerProxy("http://127.0.0.1:52795/xmlrpc/2/object")
def read(model,domain,fields):
 return rpc.execute_kw("lab_client",uid,"admin",model,"search_read",[domain],{"fields":fields})
inv=json.loads((root/".odoo-agents/flow-artifacts/needs-review/inventory.json").read_text())
rows=read("ir.model.fields",[["model","=","x_lab_request"]],list(inv["fields"][0]))
current={x["id"]:x for x in rows}
unchanged=all(current.get(x["id"])==x for x in inv["fields"])
added=[x for x in rows if x["id"] not in {v["id"] for v in inv["fields"]}]
xmlids=read("ir.model.data",[["module","=","studio_customization"]],["name","model","res_id","studio","noupdate"])
mods=read("ir.module.module",[["name","in",["base","web_studio","studio_customization"]]],["name","state","latest_version","installed_version"])
pack=json.loads(p.read_text())
result={"version":common.version(),"modules":mods,"initial_fields_identical_in_inventoried_attributes":unchanged,"added_fields":added,"studio_xmlids":xmlids,"pack_sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"pack_records":len(pack["records"]),"unresolved": "unresolved" in p.read_text().lower()}
with log.open("a") as f: f.write("\nRead-only RPC inspection:\n"+json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
assert unchanged and len(added)==1
assert added[0]["name"]=="x_studio_needs_review"
assert len(pack["records"])==1 and not result["unresolved"]

PY
